config.title: Reusable Button

intro.title: Reusable Button
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable button component in Vue. You'll learn how to create a custom component that accepts props to customize its appearance and behavior. The core concept is component reusability, allowing you to use the same button with different labels, styles, and actions throughout your app. You'll work with Vue's single-file component structure, using the template, script, and style sections. By the end, you'll have a flexible button that can be easily integrated and customized in any Vue project.
intro.usecase: Reusable buttons are foundational components in every modern web application. You'll find them in e-commerce checkout flows, dashboard action panels, form submissions, and navigation menus across platforms like Shopify admin interfaces, GitHub's UI, or Notion's toolbar. As a Vue developer, creating a reusable button component ensures consistent styling, behavior, and accessibility across your entire application while reducing code duplication. This pattern allows you to maintain a unified design system while efficiently building interactive interfaces.

objectives: Construct a Vue component that defines a reusable button.
Configure the button component to accept props for dynamic text and type.
Implement event handling to emit custom click events from the button.
Apply conditional styling to the button based on its type prop.
Integrate the reusable button component into a parent component.
Manipulate the parent component's state in response to button clicks.
Initialize and bind multiple button instances with different configurations.
